The university also carries out educational projects. An example is the first Slovenian telescope in Chile, GoChile, a project of the University of Nova Gorica and the astronomy magazine Spika. It provides students and pupils with free access to the remotely operated GoChile telescope, allowing them to conduct astronomical observations from school or home.
